title: Chiron Real Estate Inc. Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: –Advances Portfolio Repositioning Through SHOP Acquisitions and Legacy Asset Sales– –Expands Senior Housing Leadership Platform to Support Next Phase of Growth– Chiron Real Estate Inc. (NYSE: XRN) (the “Company” or “Chiron”), today announced financial results for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and other data. Mark Decker, Jr., Chief Executive Officer and President stated, "When we outlined our priorities earlier this year, we committed to active capital allocation, portfolio repositioning, and building the capabilities necessary to support our next phase of growth. During the second quarter, we made meaningful progress on each objective. We completed our inaugural SHOP acquisitions, monetized legacy assets at attractive valuations, strengthened our leadership team, and continued to redeploy capital into investments that we believe offer superior long-term return potential.
